segments.name: B-TRAN technology
segments.description: Develops and commercializes B-TRAN® bidirectional solid-state switch technology for power semiconductor markets including EV contactors and circuit protection.
segments.evidence: We are solely focused on the further development and commercialization of our Bidirectional bipolar junction TRANsistor ("B-TRAN®") solid-state switch technology.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase B-TRAN® prototypes and packaged devices in small quantities for evaluation, and the company earns grant revenue for bidirectional power switch development.
revenueModel.evidence: To date, our customers have purchased prototypes in small quantities for evaluation and provided us feedback that has been incorporated into our final product designs.
